purpose: Compose a bounded workspace and a nonmodal resizable side or bottom sheet that pushes its content.
behaviorProvider: Native in-flow section and separator with sheet-state sizing helpers, ResizeObserver and pointer capture.

requirements.statement: Keep content mounted in the workspace and conditionally mount the sheet at bottom, left or right. No viewport portal, modal backdrop or focus trap is created.
Use controlled open/size when supplied, otherwise local defaults. Emit clamped integer size changes through onSizeChange; nonfinite size falls back to the computed minimum.
Measure the workspace inner axis minus padding and gap, reserve contentMinSize and reconcile minimum/maximum to available space. Lock resizing when both computed bounds are equal.
Capture the primary pointer and resize on the placement axis. Release active drag on completion, cancellation, lost capture, blur, placement change or unmount.
Expose separator orientation and numeric values; grow toward the workspace for the relevant placement arrow, shrink with its opposite, use Shift for a larger step and Home/End for bounds.
Close through its button or unhandled Escape inside the panel. If panel focus would be lost, restore a connected restoreFocusRef or remembered opener only while document focus remains on body.
Supply finite coherent constraints and measurable workspace dimensions, then apply controlled state callbacks. Geometry adapts to the containing workspace rather than detecting product breakpoints.
Preserve sheet drafts across closing when necessary and own initial focus or routing. Arbitrary header/footer content must provide its own accessible controls.
Own pattern or component styling consumes surface group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No modal isolation, automatic initial focus, universal route interception or persisted sheet state.
The optional sheet subtree unmounts when closed; the main content remains mounted.
Constraints other than the requested size require finite host inputs.
